svg.title: Average weight loss: without vs with type 2 diabetes
svg.desc: Mean percent body-weight change, intention-to-treat style estimands. Wegovy 2.4 mg: 14.9% without diabetes (STEP 1, 68 weeks) vs 9.6% with diabetes (STEP 2, 68 weeks). Retatrutide 12 mg: 25.0% without diabetes (TRIUMPH-1, 80 weeks) vs 18.8% with diabetes (TRIUMPH-2, 80 weeks). Placebo: 2.4%, 3.4%, 3.9%, 5.1%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
